extraction_notes: Main-text performance figures are Figures 4–9. Equilibrium curves in Figure 7 were skipped. Stability plots in Figure 6 were treated according to the rule: only first and last plotted points were digitised. Figure 4b and Figure 7/9d contain several closely spaced overlapping temperature-series markers; to avoid wrong series assignments, the extraction includes the clearly assigned optimised Fe–SDC series and key comparison points, while noting that minor overlapping plotted points were not exhaustively transcribed. All plotted numerical values are approximate readings from the page images and have qualifier '~'. Common experimental conditions: fixed-bed reactor; 300 mg catalyst after reduction; H2/N2 = 3/1; total flow usually 80 mL min−1 except flow-rate panels (Figures 4c and 9b); rate is per total catalyst mass.
